name: mockix-monorepo
description: Simulador de APIs local primero: núcleo, CLI y app de escritorio.
author: Luis E. Bautista

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mockix/core && npm run build -w @mockix/cli && npm run build -w @mockix/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/cli && npm run typecheck -w @mockix/desktop
scripts.test:e2e: vitest run -c vitest.e2e.config.ts && npm run test:e2e -w @mockix/desktop
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @mockix/desktop
